message: Split View tiles pages: drop a tab on the top or bottom edge of a page to stack it there, on the outer edge of the split to give it the full height or width, or on the middle of another page to swap the two. The split's menu offers ready-made arrangements for two, three and four pages, a tab's menu can pick its card up to move with the pointer, and the bars between pages drag either way, with each window keeping the sizes you choose.
